key_idea: Try all four 90-degree rotations of the plan at every placement and minimise the covered sum.
sketch: Rotate the s x t pattern four times (no flips), and for each orientation slide it over every top-left position where it fits, summing ages under '#' cells. Answer is total minus the minimum covered sum. Complexity 4*(rc)*(st) <= 4*400*400 operations. Pitfalls: a rotated plan has swapped dimensions and may fit even when another orientation does not; flipping is not allowed, so only generate true rotations.
